item.title: Black Friday at Bird-in-Hand — Fri Nov 27, 9:00 AM — Bird-in-Hand Artisan Village
item.description:
Brighten your day by stopping to shop at Artisan Village Why fight the crowded parking lots and long register lines at the big box stores just to buy more of the same old, same old? And why take a chance shopping online for items whose quality you can’t see for yourself? And will they arrive in time for holiday gift giving? Shop for unique, handcrafted merchandise from dozens of local vendors working in ceramic, wood, leather, wool and other media. You’ll find one-of-a kind jewelry, heirloom quality furniture and toys, fashion accessories, housewares and home décor, and much more, as well as a selection of locally produced gourmet treats that make welcome hostess gifts. Make a day of it, with lunch at our Bakery & Cafe next door. And just footsteps away, continue your shopping spree at Modish Lancaster, Creative Rustic Furniture, Downingtown Vintage at Bird-in-Hand and Fisher’s Quilts. Date: Friday, November 27 Time: 9 a.m. – 5 p.m.
Source: Bird-in-Hand

At Bird-in-Hand Artisan Village, we celebrate entrepreneurship every day, but this year on Small Business Saturday, we’re doing something special. Meet the makers, sample local food products and shop our carefully curated collection of locally made merchandise, including one-of-a kind jewelry, heirloom quality furniture and toys, fashion accessories, housewares and home décor, and much more, as well as a selection of locally produced gourmet treats that make welcome hostess gifts. item.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour — Fri Oct 30, 9:00 AM — Unique Lancaster
item.description:
Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally!
Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century.
Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI.
But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region.
